reason: App UX, 14 November 2026: web/app.js gains a home-page Clear answered record control that wipes the practice seen list (and, from the same confirm, can empty the wrong-answer book) without touching mock-exam history, an exam in progress, language or theme; practice sessions show the current item over the length of that session pool, restarting at 1 when a new round begins. tests/app.test.cjs covers both behaviours.
